name: portal-viaticos-prototype
description: Starmedica · Portal de Viáticos 2.0 — cumulative visual/behavioral reference prototype (US-01 Layout + US-02 Pantallas de Inicio approved; open stories included in prototype/ snapshot). Not production code.

runtime.note: Zero build step. Plain ES modules + CSS, served statically. Any static HTTP server works (ES modules do not load from file://).
runtime.fonts: Roboto 400/500/700 via Google Fonts CDN (index.html). Self-host for offline use.
runtime.icons: Inline SVG paths in src/config/icons.js (single map), exported as public/assets/icons/*.svg. Geometry follows Lucide (ISC); equivalent Lucide names documented for lucide-angular / @lucide/* consumers.
